# Configuration

relgap reads its settings in layers, and a later layer wins: the defaults, the user file (`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/relgap/config.yaml`), the project file (`.relgap.yaml`, found by walking up from the working directory), environment variables and flags. `relgap config show --sources` prints each value and its layer, and `relgap config init` writes the commented template at the end of this page. Files are checked against [config-v1.json](/schemas/config-v1.json).

A key's environment variable is `RELGAP_` followed by the key in upper case, with dots and dashes as underscores. Only scalars and string lists (comma-separated) can be set this way. See [environment variables](/reference/environment).

## schema_version

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `integer` | `1` | `1` | `RELGAP_SCHEMA_VERSION` |  |

Config file format version.

## github

### github.host

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `github.com` |  | `RELGAP_GITHUB_HOST` |  |

Reserved for GitHub Enterprise Server. relgap doesn't read it yet and always calls github.com.

### github.concurrency

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `integer` | `8` | at least 1 | `RELGAP_GITHUB_CONCURRENCY` | `--concurrency` |

Maximum concurrent requests per tool.

## cache

### cache.dir

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` |  | `RELGAP_CACHE_DIR` |  |

Cache directory. Empty means $XDG\_CACHE\_HOME/relgap.

### cache.ttl_override

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `map of string` | `{}` |  |  |  |

Per-source TTL overrides as Go durations, e.g. {endoflife: 24h}.

## scan

### scan.roots

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of string` | `[]` |  | `RELGAP_SCAN_ROOTS` |  |

Directories scanned by drift and pins when no roots are given.

### scan.exclude

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of string` | `["**/node_modules/**","**/.terragrunt-cache/**"]` |  | `RELGAP_SCAN_EXCLUDE` |  |

Glob patterns excluded from scanning.

### scan.detectors.ci_actions

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | `false` |  | `RELGAP_SCAN_DETECTORS_CI_ACTIONS` |  |

Also report the uses: pins of GitHub Actions in workflow files. Tool versions in CI files are read either way.

### scan.detectors.generic

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | `false` |  | `RELGAP_SCAN_DETECTORS_GENERIC` |  |

Detect NAME\_VERSION=x.y.z assignments in extra\_files.

### scan.extra_files

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of string` | `[]` |  | `RELGAP_SCAN_EXTRA_FILES` |  |

Extra glob patterns read by the renovate-comment detector, and by the generic detector when it is on.

## tools

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `map of object` | `{}` |  |  |  |

Local tool overrides and additions, keyed by tool name.

Each entry has these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `repo` | `string` | GitHub owner/repo. |

## aliases

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `map of string` | `{}` |  |  |  |

Maps a raw pin name (e.g. TG\_VERSION) to a tool name.

## ignore

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of object` | `[]` |  |  |  |

Tools (optionally limited to paths) that are never reported.

Each entry has these fields:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tool` | `string` | Tool name, as pins and digests show it, to leave out of reports. |
| `path` | `string` | Glob; when set, the tool is ignored only under matching paths. |

## policy

### policy.fail_on

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `list of string` | `[]` | `breaking`, `deprecation`, `eol`, `vuln`, `drift`, `outdated` | `RELGAP_POLICY_FAIL_ON` | `--fail-on` |

--fail-on values each command uses when the flag is not given; a command ignores the values it doesn't check.

### policy.max_behind

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` | pattern `^((major\|minor\|patch\|releases\|days):[0-9]+)?$` | `RELGAP_POLICY_MAX_BEHIND` | `--max-behind` |

e.g. minor:2, releases:10, days:90.

### policy.min_confidence

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `number` | `0.5` | at least 0 | `RELGAP_POLICY_MIN_CONFIDENCE` | `--min-confidence` |

Entries below this confidence are hidden.

### policy.vuln_severity

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` | ``, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `critical` | `RELGAP_POLICY_VULN_SEVERITY` | `--vuln-severity` |

Lowest OSV rating --fail-on vuln counts; empty counts every advisory.

## llm

### llm.provider

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` | ``, `openai-compatible`, `anthropic`, `bedrock`, `bedrock-mantle` | `RELGAP_LLM_PROVIDER` |  |

Empty disables the summarizer.

### llm.model

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` |  | `RELGAP_LLM_MODEL` |  |

Model ID the provider runs. Required when provider is set.

### llm.base_url

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` |  | `RELGAP_LLM_BASE_URL` |  |

API base URL. Required for openai-compatible; anthropic and bedrock-mantle have a default.

### llm.api_key_env

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` |  | `RELGAP_LLM_API_KEY_ENV` |  |

Name of the env var holding the API key. Keys are never read from files.

### llm.api

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` | ``, `messages`, `chat-completions` | `RELGAP_LLM_API` |  |

bedrock-mantle only. Empty means messages for anthropic.\* model IDs and chat-completions otherwise.

### llm.aws_profile

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `""` |  | `RELGAP_LLM_AWS_PROFILE` |  |

AWS profile for bedrock and bedrock-mantle. Empty means the default credentials.

### llm.max_input_tokens

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `integer` | `30000` | at least 1 | `RELGAP_LLM_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS` |  |

Largest prompt, in estimated tokens. Lower-confidence entries are dropped first to fit.

### llm.timeout

| Type | Default | Allowed | Environment | Flag |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | `120s` | pattern `^([0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?(ns\|us\|µs\|ms\|s\|m\|h))+$` | `RELGAP_LLM_TIMEOUT` |  |

Hard limit on the model call, as a Go duration. A timeout is a warning.

## Template

`relgap config init` writes this file:

```yaml
# relgap configuration, written by 'relgap config init'.
# Each key below is commented out and shows its default. Uncomment a key to change it.
# Later layers win: defaults < user file < project file < env (RELGAP_*) < flags.
# 'relgap config show --sources' prints every effective value and where it came from, and
# 'relgap config validate' checks this file. Unknown keys are errors. Every key is described
# at https://relgap.sasskovacs.dev/reference/config.
schema_version: 1
#
# github:
#   host: github.com              # reserved; relgap always calls github.com for now
#   concurrency: 8                # GitHub requests in flight, 1 to 64; 2 at most without a token
#
# cache:
#   dir: ""                       # empty means $XDG_CACHE_HOME/relgap
#   ttl_override: {}              # per-source TTLs as Go durations, for example {endoflife: 24h}
#
# scan:
#   roots: []                     # what drift and pins scan when you name no directory
#   exclude:                      # globs that are never scanned
#     - '**/node_modules/**'
#     - '**/.terragrunt-cache/**'
#   detectors:
#     ci_actions: false           # also report GitHub Actions uses: pins in workflow files
#     generic: false              # read NAME_VERSION=x.y.z lines in extra_files
#   extra_files: []               # globs the renovate-comment and generic detectors read, e.g. ["Makefile"]
#
# tools: {}                       # local registry entries, for example {hk: {repo: jdx/hk}}
# aliases: {}                     # raw pin name to tool, for example {TG_VERSION: terragrunt}
# ignore: []                      # pins never reported, for example [{tool: terraform, path: "**/legacy/**"}]
#
# policy:                         # defaults for the CI flags
#   fail_on: []                   # breaking, deprecation, eol, vuln, drift, outdated
#   max_behind: ""                # for example minor:2, releases:10 or days:90; empty allows any lag
#   min_confidence: 0.5           # hide entries below this confidence, 0 to 1
#   vuln_severity: ""             # low, medium, high or critical; empty counts every advisory
#
# llm:                            # only for 'relgap digest --summarize'
#   provider: ""                  # empty is off; openai-compatible, anthropic, bedrock or bedrock-mantle
#   model: ""                     # required with a provider
#   base_url: ""                  # required for openai-compatible; empty means the provider default
#   api_key_env: ""               # env var with the API key (anthropic: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); never a key
#   api: ""                       # bedrock-mantle: messages or chat-completions; empty picks by model ID
#   aws_profile: ""               # bedrock and bedrock-mantle; empty means the AWS default chain
#   max_input_tokens: 30000
#   timeout: 120s                 # Go duration, at most 2m
```
